Apply re-plans the file against the environment and performs the operations in one

 import operation lacks its confirmation, or when a provision name is not a service the plan
 creates; the error carries an ApplyRefusal detail.

loco.workspace.v1.RetentionDays.description: RetentionDays is how many days to keep each signal's rows.

logRetentionDays.title: log_retention_days
logRetentionDays.description:
log_retention_days, trace_retention_days and metric_retention_days set how many days the
 workspace keeps each signal, from 1 to the organization's limit; 0 clears the workspace's value.
 A change applies to records ingested after it.

loco.workspace.v1.UpdateWorkspaceRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceRequest
loco.workspace.v1.UpdateWorkspaceRequest.description: UpdateWorkspaceRequest is the request to update a workspace.

loco.workspace.v1.UpdateWorkspaceRespons.title: UpdateWorkspaceResponse
loco.workspace.v1.UpdateWorkspaceRespons.description: UpdateWorkspaceResponse is the response containing the updated workspace ID.

retention.title: retention
retention.description:
retention is the workspace's own days per signal; an unset field leaves the signal to its
 organization's limit.

effectiveRetention.title: effective_retention
effectiveRetention.description:
effective_retention is how many days ingest keeps each signal, with every field set: the
 workspace's own value capped by its organization's limit.

resourceCount.title: resource_count
resourceCount.description:
resource_count is how many resources the workspace holds. GetWorkspace sets it, and
 ListOrgWorkspaces sets it on each workspace the caller can read.

memberCount.title: member_count
memberCount.description:
member_count is how many users hold a direct grant on the workspace. An organization admin
 without one is not counted. GetWorkspace sets it, and ListOrgWorkspaces sets it on each
 workspace the caller can read.

environmentCount.title: environment_count
environmentCount.description:
environment_count is how many environments the workspace holds. GetWorkspace sets it, and
 ListOrgWorkspaces sets it on each workspace the caller can read.

webhookCount.title: webhook_count
webhookCount.description:
webhook_count is how many webhooks the workspace holds. GetWorkspace sets it, and
 ListOrgWorkspaces sets it on each workspace the caller can read.

tags.name: loco.admin.v1.SystemRoleService
tags.description:
SystemRoleService lists, grants and revokes installation roles. Listing requires system read;
 granting and revoking require system admin.

tags.name: loco.cluster.v1.RegionAdminService
tags.description:
RegionAdminService lists the regions clusters run in. A region is the region code its clusters
 carry; CreateCluster builds new codes.

tags.name: loco.agent.v1.AgentService
tags.description: AgentService handles communication between the control plane and data plane agents.

tags.name: loco.token.v1.TokenService
tags.description: TokenService manages personal access tokens and fine-grained tokens.

tags.name: loco.user.v1.UserService
tags.description: UserService manages user accounts and operations.

tags.name: loco.config.v1.ConfigService
tags.description: ConfigService provides static configuration values. Clients can query this to show safe defaults.

tags.name: loco.environment.v1.EnvironmentService
tags.description: EnvironmentService manages environments within a workspace.

tags.name: loco.ingest.v1.IngestService
tags.description: IngestService authorizes telemetry that worker clusters send to the observability proxy.

tags.name: loco.observability.v1.ObservabilityService
tags.description: ObservabilityService queries the telemetry the selected regional control plane stores in ClickHouse.

tags.name: loco.plan.v1.PlanService
tags.description: PlanService diffs a loco.yaml file against an environment.

tags.name: loco.registry.v1.RegistryService
tags.description: RegistryService issues the credentials worker clusters present to the registry token endpoint.

tags.name: loco.resource.v1.ResourceService
tags.description: ResourceService manages resource lifecycle and operations.

tags.name: loco.secret.v1.SecretService
tags.description:
SecretService stores the named secret values of one environment. Any resource in the environment
 reads one by referring to it from a variable as ${{ secrets.NAME }}. Values are write-only: no RPC
 returns one.

tags.name: loco.workspace.v1.WorkspaceService
tags.description: WorkspaceService manages workspaces and their members.
